name: POST /api/crm/activities/call - Log a call on the timeline
description: Log a call on the contact/lead timeline with its structured telephony fields: direction, disposition, duration, phone number, recording url + recording consent, and the provider call id. Emits crm.call.missed.v1 when the disposition means nobody picked up (no_answer/busy/failed) and crm.call.logged.v1 otherwise. Edge cases: writes are IDEMPOTENT on external_call_id (partial unique index) because telephony webhooks retry — re-logging the same provider call id UPDATES the existing timeline entry in place rather than appending a duplicate, and deliberately does NOT re-emit the domain event, so downstream consumers cannot double-count one call; validation happens before the insert so an unknown call_disposition, an unknown call_direction, or a negative call_duration_seconds returns a 400 listing every offending field instead of a raw Postgres CHECK violation surfacing as a 500; 400 when encounter_id or actor_persona_id is missing; activities with no external_call_id (manually logged calls) are unconstrained and may repeat. AI CALLS (0892cb5b-f0d4-43a5-b3db-770361137b1b#AC2 — CRM call activity records actor ai_agent, agent version, summary and disposition): actor_kind is human (default) or ai_agent. An ai_agent activity must carry ai_agent_id and ai_agent_version_id (uuids — the sdk-voice-agent agent and the exact published version that handled the call, so a later prompt change never rewrites history) and may carry ai_disposition (the agent's own outcome, 1-64 chars, e.g. meeting_booked / callback_requested), kept beside call_disposition which stays the telephony outcome; summary holds the post-call summary. sdk-voice-agent writes these automatically when an AI call linked to a crm_encounter_id ends (external_call_id voice-agent:<call_id>, so a re-report updates rather than duplicates). A human activity must not carry any ai_* field (400). The emitted crm.call.* event payload includes actor_kind, ai_agent_id, ai_agent_version_id and ai_disposition. Enforced in the DB by activity_ai_agent_ref_check (sdk-crm migration 009).
